description.zh:
是否开启增强型 VPN 网关的路由自动传播功能。取值： - **true**：开启。
开启路由自动传播后，增强型 VPN 网关实例会自动学习 VPC 实例系统路由表中的系统路由，并向 VPC 实例系统路由表自动传播本地数据中心的路由。 - **false**：关闭。
关闭路由自动传播前，请确保增强型 VPN 网关下的所有 IPsec 连接已关闭 BGP 动态路由功能。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic route propagation for the enhanced VPN gateway. Valid values: - **true**
The enhanced VPN gateway automatically learns system routes from the system route table of the VPC and propagates routes from the on-premises data center to the system route table of the VPC.
- **false**
Automatic route propagation is disabled. Before you disable this feature, make sure that BGP dynamic routing is disabled for all IPsec-VPN connections of the enhanced VPN gateway.

description.zh:
客户端 Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用 API 请求的 RequestId 作为 ClientToken 标识。每次 API 请求的 RequestId 不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate a token from your client to make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify a `ClientToken`, the system automatically uses the `RequestId` of the API request as the `ClientToken`. Each API request has a different `RequestId`.

description.zh:
增强型 VPN 网关新的描述信息。

描述信息长度为 1～100 个字符。
description.en:
The new description of the enhanced VPN gateway.

The description must be 1 to 100 characters in length.

description.zh:
增强型 VPN 网关的新名称。

长度为 2～100 个字符，不能以http://或https://开头，需要以大写或小写字母开头，后面可包含大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和半角句号（.），不支持其他特殊字符。
description.en:
The new name of the enhanced VPN gateway.

The name must be 2 to 100 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 增强型 VPN 网关实例所在的地域 ID。您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域 ID。
description.en: The ID of the region where the enhanced VPN gateway is located. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to obtain the region ID.

description.zh: 增强型 VPN 网关实例的 ID。
description.en: The ID of the enhanced VPN gateway.

title.zh: 修改增强型VPN网关的名称、描述信息或路由自动传播功能
title.en: Modify the name, description, or automatic BGP route propagation feature of an enhanced VPN Gateway

descriptions.zh:
- **UpdateEnhancedVpnGateway** 接口属于异步接口，即系统先返回增强型 VPN 网关的信息，但该增强型 VPN 网关的配置尚未修改成功，系统后台的修改任务仍在进行。您可以调用 [DescribeVpnGateway](~~73720~~) 查询增强型 VPN 网关的配置的修改状态：
  - 当增强型 VPN 网关处于 **updating** 状态时，表示增强型 VPN 网关的配置正在修改中。
  - 当增强型 VPN 网关处于 **active** 状态时，表示 VPN 网关的配置修改成功。
- **UpdateEnhancedVpnGateway** 接口不支持并发修改同一个增强型 VPN 网关的配置。
descriptions.en:
- **UpdateEnhancedVpnGateway** is an asynchronous API. A call returns information about the Enhanced VPN Gateway, but the configuration is updated in the background. You can call [DescribeVpnGateway](~~73720~~) to check the status of the update:

  - If the Enhanced VPN Gateway's status is **updating**, the configuration update is in progress.

  - If the Enhanced VPN Gateway's status is **active**, the configuration update is complete.

- **UpdateEnhancedVpnGateway** does not support concurrent updates on the same Enhanced VPN Gateway.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc update-enhanced-vpn-gateway --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-42660000 --vpn-gateway-id vpn-bp1q8bgx4xnkm2ogj0000 --name myvpn --description test --auto-propagate true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc UpdateEnhancedVpnGateway --region cn-hangzhou --Description test --VpnGatewayId 'vpn-bp1q8bgx4xnkm2ogj0000' --AutoPropagate true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-42660000' --Name myvpn
